brief_summary: Four-column breakdown strip showing 60%, 65%, 75%, and TKL as a lineage rather than four independent designs. 60% is labeled 'the root' with only alpha block and modifiers. 65% adds a nav-and-arrow column, listing Bakeneko65 and Ikki68 Aurora. 75% adds a compressed function row, listing KBD75 v3, Mammoth75, QK75, and Mode Sonnet. TKL adds a full function row plus a separated nav block, listing MM Studio Class80 and Drop CTRL. A dashed bronze line beneath all four columns marks the shared case-and-plate manufacturing lineage the article argues each size inherited rather than redesigned.
